finalText: Migrated the last 13 files still calling `db.query` over to `db.execute({ sql, params })` — all under `packages/`, in the catalog, accounts, orders, billing, support, and analytics areas. Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` and the `cache.query` calls untouched, since those aren't part of this migration. The verify script confirms it: every call site moved and nothing else did.
